title: Constitution — global numbering
text:
The Constitution appears again on a new HTML page. It is a new page-local footnote, but global numbering continues at 5.1
A second occurrence on this page reuses footnote 5.1
José Afonso da Silva then receives footnote 6 on this page.2
This demonstrates the global-numbering variant: reuse remains local to each HTML page, while the visible footnote sequence continues across the website.

title: Website — global numbering
text:
This website keeps reusable-footnote identity local to each rendered HTML page, but the visible footnote numbers continue across the project.
José Afonso da Silva is cited here for the first time.1
The same source is cited again on this page, so the second call reuses footnote 1 rather than creating another note.1
The Constitution is a different source and receives footnote 2.2
Continue to the Doctrine page. Because this page contributed two canonical footnotes, the next page starts at 3.
